user_question: Calculate mean elevation for every census tract that intersects State College borough.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate mean elevation for every census tract that intersects State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve census tract polygons
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a census tract polygon dataset covering State College borough for intersection selection.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked census tract polygon dataset whose spatial coverage includes State College borough. Treat the result as a candidate pending runtime metadata inspection.

workflow_steps.title: Select tracts intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Use a spatial join to retain census tract features that intersect the supplied State College borough boundary while preserving tract geometries for zonal statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform an intersection-based spatial join between the census tract dataset and the State College borough boundary. Retain the census tract features that intersect the borough; do not guess field names or alter the tract geometry unless required by the operation.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by intersecting census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute mean DEM elevation for each census tract selected by the borough intersection.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute zonal mean elevation using the complete 30 m DEM and the selected intersecting census tract polygons. Ground the tract identifier and any required zone fields from runtime schema evidence; do not guess field names.

requirements.scope: Retrieved census tract candidate must cover State College borough.
The census tract candidate and State College borough boundary must have compatible CRSs for the spatial join.
Census tract and borough geometries must be valid for intersection-based selection.
The DEM and selected intersecting tract polygons must have compatible CRSs for zonal statistics.
The selected tract layer must contain a field that uniquely identifies each census tract so the output reports one mean per tract.
The DEM must cover the selected intersecting census tract zones; the supplied complete DEM candidate is input_2.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Raster Analysis Agent
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic raster reprojection, resampling, clipping, raster calculation, and zonal statistics. Consumes GeoTIFF rasters and GeoPackage polygon zones.

skills.name: Raster Geoprocessing
skills.description: Executes raster calculations, reprojections, grid resampling, spatial masking, and zonal aggregations.

constraints.spatial: Raster calculation requires compatible grid definitions and CRS. Zonal statistics require matching CRS between raster and GeoPackage zones.
other: Accepts GeoTIFF (.tif) rasters and GeoPackage (.gpkg) polygon zones.
Does not accept GeoJSON zones for zonal statistics.

input_datasets.description: GeoTIFF raster file(s) and optional GeoPackage polygon zone layer.

operation.description: Explicit operation (zonal_statistics, raster_calculator, resample, clip, reproject_raster).

resolution.description: Target pixel resolution in meters for resampling.

target_crs.description: Target coordinate reference system for raster reprojection.
